The Android app's store texts sit where F-Droid looks for them, and every store calls the app just KnightLoader. Every change is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## ⚡ Improved

- **The store texts and pictures live in `fastlane/` at the root of the repository,** where F-Droid reads them. They were under `mobile/fastlane/`, which F-Droid does not search.
- **Every store lists the app as KnightLoader,** without a tagline after the name.
